Package org.bremersee.samba.ad.dc.model

Interface SamAccount

All Superinterfaces:
AdEntry, Comparable<SamAccount>, DistinguishedNameProvider, NameProvider, Serializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
DomainComputer, DomainGroup, DomainGroupMember, DomainUser, SamAccountIntermediate
All Known Implementing Classes:
ImmutableDomainComputer, ImmutableDomainGroup, ImmutableDomainUser
public interface SamAccount extends AdEntry, NameProvider, Comparable<SamAccount>
The base of a 'SamAccount' like 'User', 'Group' and 'Computer'.
